paragraphs.text: At the end the song does something new: it dates itself and signs its name — composed in the month of Pausha, on the dark tenth, by Abhinavagupta — and then it turns outward. The compassionate Lord cools the whole worlds heat in an instant.
See the arc: what began inside one heart ends out in the world. Private recognition cools public heat.
